content.value_statement: B2B SaaS teams often need coordinated acquisition plans across paid media, SEO, partnerships, and CRM reporting. This skill provides practical playbooks, templates, and CAC guidance for predictable pipeline growth.
actual_capabilities: Create campaign briefs with objectives, audiences, budgets, channels, and success metrics.
Compare paid media channels with CAC benchmarks, conversion expectations, and scaling rules.
Guide HubSpot campaign tracking, lead scoring, attribution reports, and sales handoff workflows.
Build SEO plans covering technical checks, keyword tiers, page templates, and link building tactics.
Design partnership and affiliate programs with commission structures, tracking links, and enablement kits.
Calculate blended and channel-specific customer acquisition cost from supplied spend and customer data.
limitations: It does not connect to live ad accounts, analytics tools, or HubSpot data.
It relies on user-provided budgets, conversion metrics, and campaign context.
Benchmarks are directional and should be adjusted for market, segment, and deal size.
It provides planning guidance, not legal review for privacy, advertising, or data regulations.

use_cases.title: Plan a quarterly acquisition program
use_cases.description: Create a full-funnel plan with channel mix, budget allocation, campaign goals, HubSpot tracking, and sales handoff rules.

use_cases.title: Improve channel efficiency
use_cases.description: Review LinkedIn, Google, Meta, and retargeting campaigns against CAC benchmarks, bid strategies, and creative testing guidance.

use_cases.title: Launch partner-sourced pipeline
use_cases.description: Define partner tiers, outreach messaging, commission options, co-marketing plans, and UTM-based reporting workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic campaign brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a demand generation campaign brief for a B2B SaaS product. Include audience, offer, channels, budget, timeline, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare acquisition channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, SEO, and partnerships for our Series A B2B SaaS company. Recommend a monthly budget split and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose CAC performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these channel results and calculate CAC: LinkedIn spend $15000 with 10 customers, Google spend $12000 with 20 customers, SEO spend $5000 with 15 customers. Recommend what to scale or pause.

prompt_templates.title: Build an integrated growth system
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a 90-day acquisition operating plan for EU and US expansion. Include paid media, SEO, partnerships, HubSpot attribution, experimentation cadence, and MQL to SQL handoff rules.

output_examples.input: Plan a LinkedIn campaign for enterprise SaaS buyers.
output: Campaign objective: Generate qualified demo requests from enterprise software accounts.
Audience: Director and above at companies with 500 to 5000 employees in target regions.
Budget: Start with a controlled daily budget and increase only when CAC stays below target.
Offer: Industry benchmark report for consideration stage and demo CTA for decision stage.
Measurement: Track MQLs, SQLs, cost per opportunity, and MQL to SQL conversion rate in HubSpot.

output_examples.input: Help me improve high CAC across acquisition channels.
output: LinkedIn should be reviewed for audience quality, creative fatigue, and lead form quality.
Google Search should separate brand, competitor, solution, and category terms for clearer bidding.
SEO should prioritize high-intent comparison pages before broad awareness content.
Partnerships should be measured by partner-sourced pipeline, not only lead volume.

output_examples.input: Create a partnership program for a B2B SaaS company.
output: Start with strategic partners that share the same customer profile but do not compete directly.
Use co-marketing, integrations, and referral fees as the first three partnership motions.
Give partners tracking links, sales collateral, launch emails, and monthly performance reports.
Review partner performance by referred leads, SQLs, pipeline, revenue, and partner CAC.

best_practices: Define target CAC, SQL criteria, and attribution model before launching paid campaigns.
Test campaigns for at least two weeks before scaling budgets or stopping promising experiments.
Connect campaign planning to HubSpot tracking, lead scoring, reporting, and sales follow-up rules.
anti_patterns: Do not scale ad spend before validating conversion quality and cost per opportunity.
Do not rely only on last-touch attribution for long B2B buying journeys.
Do not treat SEO, paid media, and partnerships as separate programs without shared pipeline reporting.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Demand generation managers, paid media specialists, SEO leads, partnership managers, and founders planning B2B SaaS acquisition programs can use it.

faq.question: Does it manage live ad campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning, analysis, and templates. Users must apply changes inside ad platforms, analytics tools, and CRM systems.

faq.question: Can it calculate CAC?
faq.answer: Yes. It can calculate channel-level and blended CAC when the user provides spend and customer acquisition numbers.

faq.question: Does it support HubSpot workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes campaign tracking, lead scoring, attribution reporting, partner tracking, and MQL to SQL handoff workflows.

faq.question: Is it only for paid advertising?
faq.answer: No. It covers paid media, SEO, partnerships, affiliate programs, attribution, reporting, experimentation, and sales handoffs.

faq.question: Can it help with international expansion?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for EU, US, and Canada market entry, localization, channel mix, and regional budget planning.
